notes: PAGES ARE BOUND OUT OF ORDER AND THE FILER FOLIATED EVERY SHEET BY HAND — this is the wave's clearest demonstration that a page ordinal locates nothing. PDF p1 is the COVER, hand-marked 'Pg 8 of 8'; PDF p2 is the SUMMARY PAGE, hand-marked 'Pg 1 of 8'; PDF p3-p6 are four Schedule B sheets marked Pg 7 / 6 / 5 / 4 of 8 (so they run BACKWARDS through the PDF); PDF p7-p8 are two Schedule A sheets marked Pg 3 and Pg 2 of 8. Every page was classified from its own printed heading. `line_no` follows the FILER'S OWN foliation order within each side (Schedule A: Pg 2 sheet = PDF p8 first, then Pg 3 = PDF p7; Schedule B: Pg 4 = PDF p6, Pg 5 = PDF p5, Pg 6 = PDF p4, Pg 7 = PDF p3), while `page`/`row` are the absolute PDF page and the measured band index. FORM: modern_boxAF, title 'Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates', Josh Daniels Clerk/Auditor Elections Division masthead, and it prints NO 'v.' revision string anywhere — so the 2022 stock seen here is an UNVERSIONED revision, not v.4.20 / v.2.22 / v.12.23. It differs from the ADDENDUM I3 v.4.20 map in two ways worth recording: the close box IS LETTERED 'G' ('Balance at Close of Reporting Period (Box F - Box D)'), where v.4.20 leaves it unlettered; and Schedule B's columns are Date / Provider-Vendor / PURPOSE / Amount / In-Kind, i.e. a real Purpose column plus an IN-KIND TICK COLUMN on BOTH schedules. Schedule A's third column is headed 'City and State' and prints no street line at all, so the privacy reduction is native to the form on this side and no address was ever in reach; expenditure rows carry no address field. NO CHECKLIST DECOY IS BOUND INTO THIS FILING — all 8 pages are the report itself (1 cover + 1 summary + 6 schedule sheets), and the summary page carries real figures in every box. CENTS CONVENTION: this filer writes cents as a raised superscript with no decimal point (26,522 with a raised 23), and writes Boxes B and C with NO cents at all (45,276 / 52,096) — preserved as printed, not padded. Both sides close EXACTLY, and the cover ladder closes too: A 26,522.23 + B 45,276 = F 71,798.23 and F - D = 28,321.18 = G, all as printed. Page-face candidate 'Bill Lee', office written 'Commission Seat B' — both agree with index.csv. Report type: 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election', not an amendment (the No box is ticked), signed and filed 6/21/2022. The candidate's street address and phone on the cover were deliberately NOT transcribed.
